commands.name: suggest-resources
commands.summary: Quick title suggestions (top 10 matching resources of any type) for a search term

commands.name: ai-search
commands.summary: Natural-language AI search over the catalog metadata (e.g. 'Hvor mange bor i Oslo'); returns the most relevant resources

commands.name: get-dataset
commands.summary: Get full metadata for a dataset by id (JSON via the resource service): description, distributions, themes, publisher, contact

commands.name: get-data-service
commands.summary: Get full metadata for an API (data service) by id (JSON via the resource service): endpoint URLs, documentation, formats, publisher

commands.name: get-concept
commands.summary: Get a concept (term definition) by id: preferred labels, definition and sources, remarks, subject, related concepts, publisher

commands.name: get-resource-rdf
commands.summary: Get the raw RDF (Turtle) description of a dataset or data service, exactly as harvested

commands.name: list-organizations
commands.summary: List publishing organizations with org number, orgPath and counts of datasets, concepts, APIs and information models

commands.name: get-organization
commands.summary: Get an organization's profile by org number: details plus counts of datasets (open, authoritative, quality score), APIs, concepts and information models

commands.name: list-data-themes
commands.summary: List EU data theme codes and labels, for the dataTheme filter

commands.name: list-los-themes
commands.summary: List the LOS (Norwegian public sector) themes and words with paths and synonyms, for the losTheme filter
